1. (Currently Amended) An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb) that has been genetically attenuated, __a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant.__

3. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom, wherein the further comprising components are present in quantities effective to enhance the immunogenic response.

4. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type la, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof, wherein said components are themselves modified to enhance immunogenicity.

6. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen, which is derived from a pathogenic microorganism associated with bovine respiratory diseases.

8. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is inactivated and is derived from a pathogen selected from the group consisting of Leptospira, Actinobacillus, and Pasteurella, or any combination thereof.

12. (Currently Amended) The vaccine of claim 4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of at least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen, wherein the antigen is selected to provide an enhanced immune response against multiple bovine pathogens.
